summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated risk scores for Ritodrine Hydrochloride, finding a low risk score of 3 for the liver and a medium risk score of 52 for the heart [M]. Looking at related medications, a similar drug called Suloctidil was pulled from the market worldwide starting in 1985 due to liver harm [3]. Another related drug, Metaproterenol, was taken off the market in the United Kingdom starting in 2009 because of heart harm [4].
